amendment_required_before_execution: Identify and audit two public non-PTB sources with authoritative patient IDs (or authoritative one-record-per-patient guarantee), then re-freeze this protocol before labels or confirmation outcomes are read.
research_question: Do evaluations based on random whole-lead masking systematically overestimate the robustness of 12-lead ECG classifiers to physically realizable electrode failures?
claim_boundary: Evaluation and failure analysis only; no successful augmentation or clinical deployment claim is required.

sources.development: one eligible non-PTB source, patient-disjoint train/validation/test
sources.confirmation: a different eligible non-PTB source, sealed until all design choices are frozen
excluded: Challenge 2020 CPSC/CPSC-Extra/Georgia unless authoritative patient linkage is added

labels.eligibility: at least 200 positive patients per selected endpoint in development test and confirmation test after source-specific split; no endpoint substitution after confirmation labels are read

inputs.sampling: resample source waveforms to 100 Hz and crop/pad a prespecified 10-second window; fit normalization on development-train patients only

models.optimizer: AdamW; weighted BCE; mixed precision; no foundation model or unavailable checkpoint

matched_controls.reversals: for every deterministic two-limb-terminal swap, sample fixed random two-terminal swaps from the same three-permutation universe; preserve prevalence, population, model invocation count, and bootstrap draws
matched_controls.single_chest_unavailability: six random chest-lead choices, one independent measurement unavailable; evaluate each separately inside each bootstrap replicate before metric averaging
matched_controls.coherent_chest_unavailability: random 6-of-8 independent-measurement unavailability. This is an information-budget control, not a common clinical event; report its different mechanism explicitly.
matched_controls.legacy_display_mask: whole displayed-lead zeroing retained only as a conventional secondary benchmark, matched by stored input count but never equated with electrode count
matched_controls.prohibited: never average random-mask probabilities before calculating metrics

analysis.primary_endpoint: For each class and fault: AUPRC degradation under physical fault minus matched-random degradation, with degradation = clean AUPRC - fault AUPRC.
secondary_endpoints: expected calibration error using clean-validation calibration only
rank stability across architectures and sources
analysis.bootstrap: patient-cluster percentile bootstrap, 1000 replicates minimum, synchronized condition resampling within replicate; calculate each random mask metric separately then average within replicate
analysis.multiplicity: two predeclared label families are primary; all other class/fault tables are descriptive with false-discovery-rate annotation
analysis.decision: Report source-specific estimates; pooled claim requires both sources to have directionally concordant class-specific effects and no population/split/protocol deviation. No augmentation result is part of this decision.
